data.summary: Your setup and final answer were both correct, but the method has a gap worth fixing.

strengths.text: Separated variables correctly: dy/y = x dx.

breakdown_points.what_happened: You wrote ln|y| = x^2/2 without a constant of integration.
breakdown_points.why_it_matters: Every indefinite integral has a family of solutions differing by a constant — dropping it means your 'general solution' is actually only one particular case, and you have to guess your way back to the right answer instead of solving for it.

data.next_action: Redo step 2 writing +C explicitly, then solve for C using y(0)=2 — you'll land on the same answer, but through a method that works for any initial condition.
